purpose: Classify whether four-year model candidates are only discussion-eligible or also clearly superior to the replaced research candidate.

executable_1d_open_return.note: 1D should prefer the candidate that improves both full-window RankIC and Top5 over the replaced candidate.

executable_3d_open_return.note: 3D may enter discussion even when it does not dominate the replaced candidate, but it must carry a formal explanation.

executable_5d_open_return.note: 5D prioritizes front-rank improvements and positive recent windows over pure full-window RankIC dominance.

executable_10d_open_return.note: 10D prioritizes Top5 and recent-window strength, but formal review must explain RankIC and TopN divergence if present.
